description: NSP Club AI Sponsor is an independent coaching and knowledge assistant for invited NSP Club business partners. It helps users prepare respectful prospect outreach, analyze conversations, handle objections, plan first partner meetings, develop measurable weekly activity plans, and retrieve region-aware product and wellness guidance from a private knowledge base. The assistant avoids manipulative pressure, fabricated scarcity, medical promises, and income guarantees. Access requires an NSP Club account. Created and published by Stas Falkovich. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nature's Sunshine Products, Inc.
